purpose: Common metadata conventions for screening transcript records.

confidence_policy.meaning: Speech-to-text confidence supplied by the upstream recognizer, not a measure of candidate honesty, competence, or answer quality.

fields.description: Unique identifier for a transcript document.
Unique screening session identifier; multiple turns share the session.
Candidate reference from the upstream ATS; use opaque IDs rather than names.
ID from the Day 22 question bank when a turn maps to a bank question; null for free-form or non-question turns.
UTC time for the utterance event, canonicalized with trailing Z.
ASR confidence between 0 and 1, or null when the recognizer does not provide it.
One-based order of the turn within a transcript; unique within a transcript.
Speech recognizer or typed text exactly as received, before normalization.
NFC Unicode; control characters replaced; whitespace collapsed; leading/trailing whitespace removed.
BCP 47 language tag, such as en-IN; turn-level language permits mixed-language conversations.
